settings.name_in_paper: M-player K-arm cooperative dueling bandit problem with a Condorcet winner
unmapped: M players (N in expressions) on a connected undirected communication graph; messages travel via message passing with delay d(m,m')-1 and decay parameter gamma
group regret summed over all players
settings.definition_quote: In the $M$-player $K$-arm dueling bandit problem, each player $m \in [M]$ engages in the environment at each round by drawing an arm pair $(i_m(t),j_m(t))\in [K]^2$ and receiving a Bernoulli reward feedback ... We assume there exists a Condorcet Winner (CW) ... Players are positioned on a connected undirected communication graph ... define the $M$-player cumulative regret as $\mathcal{R}(T) = \sum_{m=1}^{M}\sum_{t=1}^{T}0.5(\Delta_{1i_{m}(t)}+\Delta_{1j_{m}(t)})$.

symbols.C_DB: sum over i != 1 of min_{j in O_i} (Delta_1i + Delta_1j)/(2 KL(q_ij, 1/2)), O_i = arms beating i

conditions: consistent algorithm over Q_CW (E R(T) = o(T^p) for all p>0)

source.label: theo:DB Multi-Player Lower Bound
source.quote: For any consistent algorithm on $\mathcal{Q}_{\mathrm{CW}}$ and $Q \in \mathcal{Q}_{\mathrm{CW}}$, the group regret obeys, \liminf_{T \rightarrow \infty}\frac{\mathbb{E}\mathcal{R}(T)}{\log T}\geq \sum_{i\in [K]\setminus \{1\}}\min_{j \in \mathcal{O}_{i}}\frac{\Delta_{1i}+\Delta_{1j}}{2\mathrm{KL}(q_{ij},1/2)}.

results.notes: Independent of number of players M. Regret defined via preference gaps (pseudo-regret).

symbols.g_base: expected regret bound g(K,T,Q) of the single-player base algorithm
symbols.f_base: bound f(K,T,Q) on expected number of rounds the base algorithm's CW candidate is wrong

tuning: deterministic leader election completing in T_LE rounds

symbols.Delta_1i: preference gap q_1i - 1/2 of arm i vs the Condorcet winner

source.label: corollary:FYLRMED

results.notes: Leading term has exact constant; O applies only to the additive term. Paper writes '=' but it is an upper bound.

symbols.C_DB: sum over i != 1 of min_{j in O_i} (Delta_1i + Delta_1j)/(2 KL(q_ij, 1/2))

source.label: corollary:FYLRMED
source.quote: (b) For RMED2FH as the base algorithm, \mathbb{E}\mathcal{R}(T) =\sum_{i=2}^{K}\min_{j \in \mathcal{O}_{i}}\frac{\Delta_{1i}+\Delta_{1j}}{2\mathrm{KL}(q_{ij},1/2)}\log T+O\left(M(D+K^{2+\epsilon}\log\log T)+\frac{K\log T}{\log\log T}\right)

results.notes: Leading term exactly matches lower bound of Theorem 3.1 (asymptotically optimal).

symbols.chi_G: clique covering number of the gamma-power graph G_gamma
symbols.C_hat: non-leading constant defined in Theorem 5.2 (depends on M, K, gamma, Delta_1max, cliques, D-scale sum of 4 alpha/Delta-bar^2)

source.label: theorem: MP
source.quote: Let $\chi(\mathcal{G}_{\gamma})$ denote the clique covering number of $\mathcal{G}_{\gamma}$. Then for any $\alpha > 1.4$ and all times $T$, \mathbb{E}\mathcal{R}(T) \leq \sum_{j>1}\frac{2\alpha \chi(\mathcal{G}_{\gamma})}{\Delta_{1j}}\log T+\hat{C}~.

results.notes: Algorithm does not use T in its index (log t), bound holds for all T. With complete communication (gamma = D), chi = 1; paper informally states C_hat = O(MKD + K^2 log K/Delta_1min^2 + MK^2 min{log K/Delta_1min^2, D}).

symbols.C_hat_delta: constant hat C_eps(delta) defined in Theorem E.5, polynomial in 1/delta

source.label: theorem: MP complicated
source.quote: (a) For any $\alpha$ such that $\alpha> 0.5\sqrt{\eta}(1+\epsilon)$ and all times $T$, with probability larger than $1-\delta$, \mathcal{R}(T) \leq \sum_{j>1}\frac{2\alpha \chi(\mathcal{G}_{\gamma})}{\Delta_{1j}}\log T+\hat{C}_\epsilon(\delta)

results.notes: Random regret is defined via preference gaps of drawn arms (pseudo-regret realization).

symbols.C_hat_eps: constant hat C_eps defined in Theorem E.5

source.label: theorem: MP complicated
source.quote: (b) For any $\alpha$ such that $\alpha> 0.5\sqrt{\eta}(2+\epsilon)$ and all times $T$, \mathbb{E}\mathcal{R}(T) \leq \sum_{j>1}\frac{2\alpha \chi(\mathcal{G}_{\gamma})}{\Delta_{1j}}\log T+\hat{C}_\epsilon~.

results.notes: General version of Theorem 5.2 (which takes eta=1.3, eps=1/e).
